notes.title: Version 4.7 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[h1] Major Benefit: 7-Day Login Event[/h1]

To thank all players for your love and support, we’re launching a **limited-time 7-Day Login Event** for everyone!
After the 4.7 update goes live, log in for 7 consecutive days to claim exciting rewards each day, including **choose-1-of-3 spells, an advanced spell chest, an exclusive spell skin**, and a total value of up to **60,000 gold**!

---

[h2]  New Spells[/h2]

[b]**Crow Illusion**[/b]
  A defensive spell that grants brief invincibility when the player takes damage.

[b]**Plague Rat**[/b]
  Summons a hard-to-hit rat carrying a deadly virus. Any unit it infects will die within seconds.

[b]**Achillie’s Sword**[/b]
  Starts as a small and unremarkable blade but can evolve into multiple powerful forms through upgrades.

---

[h2]New Spell Skins[/h2]

**Water Element – Water’s Abhorrence**
**Machine Gun Spell – AK47**
**God’s Wrath – True Dragon Form**

---

[h2]Spell Adjustments[/h2]

[b]**Hurricane (Rebalanc)**[/b]

* Healing effect removed
* Now removes enemy drawn spell patterns immediately upon casting

[b]**Ruyi Stick (Nerf)**[/b]

* Mana will not regenerate naturally while the spell is active
* Duration reduced from 60s to 50s

---

[h2] 2v2 Balance Changes[/h2]

* Defense tower attack speed reduced
* Increases the early-game advantage impact on match outcomes

notes.title: Halloween Haunt: War of Wizards Update!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]New Spell: Grim Reaper’s Pact[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858682/ce3de07640295b04b646f5bdfdc629c43f428437.png[/img]
[h1][b]Spells Description[/b][/h1]
Embrace the darkness with this powerful new spell! By signing a pact with death, the caster sacrifices a portion of their health to summon the Grim Reaper onto the battlefield. With a terrifying aura, the Reaper slowly drifts toward an enemy, wielding a massive scythe that can deal up to 95% of their current health in damage! This spell is a high-stakes gamble—use it wisely, as it significantly lowers your own health, but if executed perfectly, it can obliterate foes in a single, devastating strike.

Prepare to delve into the ultimate Halloween experience and dominate your enemies like never before!

notes.title: Version 3.7.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]New Spell:[/b][/h3]

[b]Frying Pan[/b]: The legendary frying pan, forged by Hera herself, Zeus’s wife, used to discipline Zeus. When you wield this frying pan, you become an invincible shield bearer. Hold it steady, and all flying projectiles will helplessly fall before you. Swing it, and the mighty force will deflect projectiles back, turning them into the enemy’s nightmare. Moreover, this magical frying pan can bat away ghost,pigman and mosquitoes. Once hit, they will be stunned for a full 15 seconds and 500 damage, rendered completely powerless!

[h3][b]Skill Adjustments:[/b][/h3]

[b]Spectral Quartet of the Abyss (Nerf)[/b]
[list]
[*] Cooldown increased from 90 seconds to 120 seconds
[*] Mana cost increased from 300 to 400
[*] Pigman’s health doubled
[*] Other ghosts' health reduced by 500
[/list]

[b]Purification (Nerf)[/b]
Cooldown increased from 60 seconds to 90 seconds

[b]Ichor Rain (Nerf)[/b]
Cooldown increased from 60 seconds to 90 seconds

[b]Tornado (Buff)[/b]
Number of damage ticks increased from 8 to 12

[h3][b]Natural Healing Mechanism Re-enabled[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where other players were not visible.
[*] Fixed the bug where the game would disconnect at the end.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 3.6 Announcement
notes.notes:
1. [b]New TASK System[/b]: Introducing daily sign-in and daily first-win tasks.

2. [b]Weekly Free Spell System[/b]: Each week, 7 free spells will be available for players to try out.

3. [b]AFK Compensation Mechanism[/b]:
If a teammate is AFK or detected as inactive for more than 3 minutes, no points will be deducted for losing the match, and winning the match will grant extra points.

Players who are AFK or engage in passive gameplay will not receive victory points.

4. [b]Network Performance Optimization[/b]: Improved the network performance to reduce occurrences of game stuttering.
